text:
sam: main CI turned red right after merge — seeing failures in the smoke and one kv test.
ci-bot: [ALERT] pipeline: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/6789 status=FAILED
nisha: ping @eli (author of CL 5267) — can you take a look? :eyes:
eli: i'm in a meeting, give me 10m. if it's urgent escalate.
taylor: what failed exactly? any log snippet?
ci-bot: failing job: gpu-smoke/shard-3
ci-bot: failing test: kv_cache_eviction_test::evict_on_alloc
ci-bot: short log:
```
2026-02-12T14:02:13Z ERROR allocator.cpp:224 OOM while allocating 1.2G on shard-3
TEST FAIL: kv_cache_eviction_test::evict_on_alloc
```
sam: I kicked a rerun: `./ci rerun 6789` — fingers crossed.
ci-bot: rerun 6790 started by sam
ci-bot: rerun 6790: most stages passed, but unit/gpu/shard-3 still FAILED
taylor: repeating on same shard suggests non-deterministic but consistent failure pattern.
nisha: can someone try a bisect between main~15 and main? could narrow to allocator PR.
sam: propose bisect range: 172e1b3...a9f4c2 — run with `ci bisect --start a9f4c2 --end HEAD --job gpu-smoke`.
eli: that range includes my allocator sketch patch — i'm going to grab bisect once I'm out of meetings (30m).
oncall-rotation: if CI doesn't stabilize in 30m, please open an incident and notify infra-oncall.
taylor: in the meantime i'll attempt a quick local reproduce with `TEST_SEED=42 bazel test //tests:kv_cache_eviction_test --runs_per_test=50`.
sam: local reproduce failed (passed 50/50) but CI still red on shard-3.
ci-bot: rerun 6791 attempted by taylor -> FAILED
nisha: attaching core dump: s3://redwood-artifacts/cores/6789/shard-3/core.20260212.gz
nisha: stack trace (extracted): `allocator::alloc_chunk -> fallback_alloc -> throw std::bad_alloc`.
eli: ok i'm reverting my allocator refactor PR now (opens PR 5289 revert) — will see if main recovers.
ci-bot: PR 5289 created: https://git.redwood/PR/5289
sam: can we hold rollouts until CI is green? adding label `hold-rollout` to main branch.
taylor: +1
ci-bot: triggered CI for revert PR -> build 6800
ci-bot: build 6800: all checks green ✅
ci-bot: main pipeline: RECOVERED after revert (build 6801) — all green :tada:
eli: sorry folks, my change was the culprit. i'll follow up with a smaller fix and more tests.
sam: thanks for quick revert and follow-up. filing short postmortem thread.
nisha: adding `ci:flaky` tag to test and creating an issue to add coverage for allocator edge cases.
eli: feel terrible but grateful for the rapid eyeballs :thumbsup:
oncall-rotation: closing handoff — won't escalate further.
